entries.description: oogiyoona woyee ikke showoo aagetooch biich beet daqqoona
entries.subject: oogiyoona woyee

spans.text: Daakkoona, poletikoona, sheeroon oogiyoona woyee ikke showoo aagetooch biich beet daqqoona, ikke men showee beeyechona yeshiitaa, men showee bi qello hakkit tunebu tunaayu, woyee bi qelloona qeyaaneenaa bare showee giidoona qeejjaabeet tunebu eb woraabbooch beet wuroon gaachecho tunneheete.
